tools.name: move_thread_to_channel
tools.description: Moves a message thread from its current channel to another channel and returns the thread's new location and reply count.

params.name: thread_id
params.description: ID of the thread to move

params.name: target_channel_id
params.description: ID of the channel to move the thread into

tools.code:
import sqlite3
from agents import function_tool


@function_tool
def move_thread_to_channel(thread_id: str, target_channel_id: str) -> dict:
    conn = sqlite3.connect("workspace.db")
    old_channel = conn.execute(
        "SELECT channel_id FROM threads WHERE id = ?", (thread_id,)
    ).fetchone()
    conn.execute("UPDATE threads SET channel_id = ? WHERE id = ?", (target_channel_id, thread_id))
    conn.execute("UPDATE messages SET channel_id = ? WHERE thread_id = ?", (target_channel_id, thread_id))
    replies = conn.execute("SELECT COUNT(*) FROM messages WHERE thread_id = ?", (thread_id,)).fetchone()[0]
    conn.commit()
    conn.close()
    return {"thread_id": thread_id, "from": old_channel[0] if old_channel else None, "to": target_channel_id, "replies": replies}

tools.name: invite_guest_to_channel
tools.description: Looks up a channel, grants a guest access to it with the chosen permission level, and emails the guest an invitation link.

params.name: channel_id
params.description: ID of the channel to share

params.name: guest_email
params.description: Email address of the guest to invite

params.name: expires_in_days
params.description: Days until the guest access expires

tools.code:
import secrets
import smtplib
import sqlite3
import time
from email.message import EmailMessage
from agents import function_tool

SMTP_HOST = "smtp.internal.example.com"
BASE_URL = "https://chat.example.com/join"


@function_tool
def invite_guest_to_channel(
    channel_id: str,
    guest_email: str,
    access_level: str = "read_only",
    expires_in_days: int = 7,
) -> dict:
    if access_level not in ("read_only", "can_post"):
        return {"error": "access_level must be 'read_only' or 'can_post'"}

    conn = sqlite3.connect("workspace.db")
    channel = conn.execute(
        "SELECT name, is_private FROM channels WHERE id = ?", (channel_id,)
    ).fetchone()
    if channel is None:
        conn.close()
        return {"error": "channel not found"}

    token = secrets.token_urlsafe(32)
    expires_at = int(time.time()) + expires_in_days * 86400
    conn.execute(
        "INSERT INTO guest_access (channel_id, email, access_level, token, expires_at) "
        "VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?)",
        (channel_id, guest_email, access_level, token, expires_at),
    )
    conn.commit()
    conn.close()

    message = EmailMessage()
    message["Subject"] = f"You have been invited to #{channel[0]}"
    message["From"] = "noreply@example.com"
    message["To"] = guest_email
    message.set_content(
        f"You have been invited to the channel #{channel[0]} with {access_level} access.\n"
        f"Join here: {BASE_URL}/{token}\n"
        f"This link expires in {expires_in_days} days."
    )

    with smtplib.SMTP(SMTP_HOST, 587) as server:
        server.starttls()
        server.send_message(message)

    return {
        "channel": channel[0],
        "guest": guest_email,
        "access_level": access_level,
        "expires_at": expires_at,
    }
